name: cellrank_trajectory
description: CellRank trajectory analysis using precomputed pseudotime to compute transition matrices and fate probabilities

pseudotime_key.description: Column name in adata.obs containing precomputed pseudotime values

kernel_type.description: Type of kernel to use: 'pseudotime' or 'velocity'

n_states.description: Number of macrostates. If null, will be automatically determined

cluster_key.description: Key in adata.obs containing clustering information
